why_this_file: The board's lead-director role is one of the phrases the approved source strategy owns for the governance family (config/source_strategy_registry.json, forbidden_production_literals), and business phrases of that list live in the catalog, not in executable code (tools/check_vnext_semantics.py). The reader inserts this phrase unescaped into four of its patterns, so it must be lower-case words separated by single spaces; the reader refuses anything else. The file's bytes are recorded by the issue_47_v1 snapshot as a rule file, so a change here moves the Requirement closure.
